observations: Photo 0: Front of a black DSLR body with 'Canon EOS 5D Mark II' text visible on the pentaprism and side plate; no lens attached, body cap on the mount.
Photo 1: Rear view showing LCD screen (screen appears dark/off, no power-on test shown), control buttons, 'Canon' logo below screen, viewfinder eyecup.
Photo 2: Bottom plate showing serial sticker 'Canon DS126201', serial number 3761814763, battery compartment door closed, tripod socket visible.
No battery, charger, lens, strap, memory card, or box visible in any photo.
No shot of the sensor (lens removed) or a powered-on screen/live view to confirm functionality.
No close-up of body corners/edges to assess cosmetic wear beyond general photos.

claims.evidence: Sensor not visible in any photo; full-frame status is a known spec for this model but not confirmed by these images.
No way to confirm sensor resolution from external photos alone.
No photo or video shows the camera powered on, screen lit, or shutter firing.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have electrical faults
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the camera powered on with the screen showing a live menu or live view.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be very high, reducing remaining mechanical life
risks.proof: A screenshot from EOS Utility or a shutter-count checking tool showing the actuation count.

risks.risk: Sensor could be dusty, scratched, or have dead pixels
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed, taken in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as sensor condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: No lens, battery, charger, or memory card included, affecting usability and total cost
risks.proof: Photos of these accessories if they are actually included.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only with no accessories

risks.risk: Possible water or impact damage not visible externally
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment interior showing the moisture/drop indicator sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming no damage cannot be confirmed, so treated as a risk factor lowering price

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear (scratches, dents) on edges not shown in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four corners and the top/bottom edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderate-to-heavy cosmetic wear assumed

proof_requests: Photo/video of the camera powered on with menu or live view visible.
Shutter count screenshot via EOS Utility or similar software.
Close-up photo of the sensor with lens removed.
Photo of any included battery, charger, lens, and memory card.
Photo of the battery compartment interior showing the moisture indicator.
Close-up photos of body corners and edges for cosmetic assessment.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly readable across three photos, so identity is certain, but no functional test, accessories, or sensor condition are shown, so the body must be priced at worst case as a non-verified, body-only unit with no accessories.
